The screen's probes with their rays moving on to the next of sixteen places in their texels each
frame and each probe keeping sixteen frames of its light before the window's filter, read on the
engine's tree against `e96a6bb8` on an RTX 4070 Laptop GPU under tuned's `powersave-bazzite`, the
bounce rooms offscreen at High at 800 by 450 and their distances at 160 by 90 as BounceRoomsTests
reads them, and the voxel game's plank room at night with a hanging lantern and two torches at 960
by 540. Spots are counted as the voxel game's entry counts them, the luminance less a Gaussian blur
of 20 pixels, spots of 40 pixels or more at 4 levels or more over it, in the frame's middle 360 rows
and the plank room's upper half.

Each pair is before, then after. A still view's change is each pixel's change from the frame before
over the frame's mean light, at the 99th part, over 16 frames. Turning a quarter degree a frame,
the views change as much with the screen's probes as with them left out, before and after, the
Cornell box 0.67 to 0.70 at the 99th part either way.

In the plank room the spots went from 5 to 2, the lantern and its glow standing in both. A still
view changes 0.021 sRGB levels a frame on the mean where 0.002, with the share of pixels past 8
levels the same, 0.00003. The eye stepping half a block over 40 frames changes the picture 0.283
levels a frame with the probes where 0.285, 0.269 with them left unread either way, and 0.029 after
the step where 0.017. Global illumination took 2.70 to 2.75 ms at 1920 by 1080 where 2.61 to 2.69,
read by turns with no other program on the GPU.

A probe keeps fewer frames where its kept light lies further from this frame's blend of its like
neighbors than three times that blend's own error, the blend's spread over the root of the
neighbors it counts. Keeping sixteen frames whatever the light did, the floor under a roof of leaves
changed from solid to letting half through took 0.167 of the sky's light it would hold back thirty
frames after where it takes about 0.30, and with the error's twice, the camera sliding through a
Cornell box added 0.25 levels a frame to the picture's change; with three times, 0.274 and 0.080.

The probes stay on the window's tiles. Their kept light follows the surface through the frame
before's camera as the blend's did, and the eye's movement reads no change the probes add past the
movement's own, so no grid of probes in the world is made.
